basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Research Scientist III Recruitment 2026 – Walkin

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for the post is 45 years.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | project research scientist iii (non-medical): Essential: Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees, with five years' post qualification experience or PhD + two years post qualification experience.Desirable: Experience in community-based projects, leadership, budget handling, data management, and proficiency in Hindi/English/local language.

salary_details.project research scientist iii (non-medi: Rs. 78,000/- + HRA as admissible per month
salary_details.details: The salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits and is based on experience, qualifications, and skill set.

selection_process: The selection process consists of a Screening/Scrutiny Test (depending on the number of applicants) followed by a Walk-In-Interview.
how_to_apply: Download the application form and format from the official notification PDF.
Fill out the prescribed application form completely and prepare your bio-data.
Gather all relevant original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies regarding age, qualifications, and relevant experience.
Attach all essential qualifications and experience certificates with the application form.
Report in person for the walk-in interview on 19 October 2026 between 09:00 AM and 10:00 AM at the designated venue.
important_instructions: Reporting time for candidates starts at 09:00 AM on 19/10/2026 and the closing time to report is 10:00 AM on the same day. The position is purely on a temporary basis, co-terminus with the project, with no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur. All educational, professional, and technical qualifications must be from a recognized Board/University and full-time. Experience requirement must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications required for the post. No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in the interview. All essential qualifications and experience certificates must be enclosed with the application form; otherwise, the application will be considered incomplete. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
